title: atractylodes lancea var. simplicifolia
intro: Atractylodes lancea var. simplicifolia, commonly known as simplified atractylodes or Chinese atractylodes, is a variety of the Atractylodes lancea plant, a type of plant native to China and other parts of Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a popular choice in traditional Chinese medicine. The therapeutic actions of Atractylodes lancea var. simplicifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, triterpenes, and polysaccharides, which have been shown to exhibit sedative, diuretic, and antimicrobial properties. Regular consumption of Atractylodes lancea var. simplicifolia is believed to promote digestive health, boost the immune system, and reduce stress and anxiety.
